postal_system.assignment_rule: Ethiopost branch observations and the dated UPU four-digit scheme are separate. A current assignment requires a permitted, successful and release-pinned operator or licensed assignment observation; branch visibility and syntax alone do not prove current allocation.
postal_system.historical_semantics_rule: The UPU Ethiopia sheet checked July 2002 describes one region digit, one central-office digit and two delivery-office digits. These are historical coding semantics, not a current assignment table, delivery guarantee, complete history or official polygon.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide official postcode polygon release is bundled or identified. Branch office points, region/zone/woreda/kebele boundaries, eDAS areas, NSDI layers, buffers, Voronoi cells and learned surfaces are not official postal polygons; permitted generated surfaces remain derived non-canonical review geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: The current Ethiopost form exposes sub-city, woreda, house number, city, province and postal-code inputs. SSGI eDAS describes building, parcel, neighbourhood and physical-location identity. Neither page is a reusable address row, assignment database, delivery proof or building crosswalk.
postal_system.building_rule: An eDAS or other building may be returned only from an exact rights-cleared artifact with a stable explicit address-to-building or parcel relation. Postcode, text match, containment, overlap, nearest feature and model score are candidates only.
postal_system.licence_rule: Website access, a UPU publication and government authorship do not grant database reuse. Every Ethiopost, UPU, SSGI, Ethio-NSDI and city artifact needs exact terms, version and digests; OSM stays in a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Restricted address, parcel, household, title, owner, query-log and credential material remains gated or external.
